sentences.en: The newspaper published a hilarious parody of the president's speech.
sentences.zh: 这家报纸刊登了一篇关于总统演讲的极其搞笑的模仿作品。

sentences.en: It was so hilarious that I snorted with laughter.
sentences.zh: 它太搞笑了，我笑得喷鼻涕。

sentences.en: Susan thought the film was hilarious, but one time was enough.
sentences.zh: 苏珊觉得这部电影非常搞笑，但她只看了一遍就够了。

senses.zh: 充满欢乐的；引起大笑的
